notes: A is NPBench's initialize() data at preset T {'N': 4, 'W': 7, 'H': 7, 'C1': 16, 'C2': 4}. B is a seeded perturbation of A (numpy RandomState(5574725)): noise 10 % of the largest magnitude; integer arrays redrawn in their range. Float tolerance: atol = 2e-06 instead of the default 1e-6, rtol = 1e-06. Why: conv2d writes its result into a float32 buffer (np.empty(..., dtype=np.float32)), which Q32 cannot imitate: the float32 rounding alone moves the output by up to 1.7e-6 (measured on A and B: 1.7e-06).
